reason: I have one or two chairs and maybe one boy working with me; ₹999 every month plus ₹4,999 upfront is too much for a shop this size when I already count the drawer myself every night. The cash check is tempting for the days I'm at my other work, but not at this price.
objection: A selfie check-in will make my staff feel I don't trust them, and in a small shop if my one good barber gets offended and leaves, I lose far more than the app could ever save me.
would_change_my_mind: A small-shop plan around ₹299-399 a month with no setup fee, where the selfie check-in can be switched off and I only get the cash-drawer and cancelled-bill check on my phone.
